          AND "closed_at" IS NULL

        )
        OR
        (
          "status" = 'closed'
          AND "closing_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "closure_reason" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )
ddl.name: ssh_relays_state_check
